newsitem.title: USA: Lloyd's says Utah joins states in settlement.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's says Utah joins states in settlement.

text.p: Lloyd's of London said on Friday that Utah had joined an agreement between the insurance market and the coordinating committee of the North American Securities Administrators Association, a group representing state securities authorities.

A Lloyd's spokesman said Utah is part of the agreement with 39 other states and the District of Columbia and that qualified Utah names, who are investors in the insurance market, will get credits under the agreement.
In July, Lloyd's reached a settlement with state securities regulators to end litigation against the insurance market that would have threatened its restructuring plan.
